turns.question: What was the total ad spend in EUR per non-cancelled order placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no metric for ad spend per non-cancelled order, so I cannot give that figure; the closest metric, Ad spend (EUR), totals 6270.0 EUR for 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30 and no per-order metric exists to divide it by. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
